notes.title: v0.1 Released!
notes.content:
[h2]🌀 Version 0.1 Now Available on Steam!
[/h2][p]We’re excited to announce that [b]Apocalypse of the Universe (v0.1)[/b] is now live on Steam!
[/p][p]Step into a world consumed by darkness, where portals to demonic realms have shattered the land. In this [b]2D platformer adventure[/b], you play as an elven warrior on a desperate mission to save his homeland from total annihilation.
[/p][h3]⚔ What Awaits You:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Challenging platforming[/b] through corrupted lands filled with traps, enemies, and secrets[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dynamic combat[/b] with a magical bow, melee attacks, and upgradeable abilities[/p][/*][*][p][b]Epic boss battles[/b] — defeat the gatekeepers and seal the demonic rifts[/p][/*][*][p][b]Exploration & progression[/b] — unlock hidden paths, solve puzzles, and level up your hero[/p][/*][*][p][b]Beautiful pixel art[/b] in a dark fantasy world[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lore-rich storytelling[/b] with cinematic moments and mysterious fragments of the past[/p][/*][/list][p]Version [b]0.1[/b] marks the [b]first public release[/b] — a solid foundation with core mechanics, combat, and several regions to explore. Your feedback will help shape what’s to come!
[/p][h3]🛡️ Ready to fight back against the darkness?[/h3][p][b]Download now on Steam[/b] and join the resistance.
[/p][p]🌑 The fate of the world rests in your hands.[/p]

notes.title: 🌙 Apocalypse of the Universe – Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[h2]🌙 APOCALYPSE OF THE UNIVERSE: DEMO EVENT AT STEAM NEXT FEST[/h2][p]Join us for [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] and get a first look at [b]Apocalypse of the Universe[/b]!
As part of the festival, you'll be able to try out the [b]demo version[/b] of the game, where you’ll step into the role of an elven hero fighting back against a demonic invasion and attempting to save their homeland from cursed portals.[/p][p]In this special preview, you will:[/p][list][*][p]Play through the first story level and battle demons at the portal,[/p][/*][*][p]Engage in a tense boss fight,[/p][/*][*][p]Try out the hero’s magical bow, special abilities, and upgrade system.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🗓️ HOW TO PARTICIPATE[/h2][list][*][p]Head over to the [b]Apocalypse of the Universe[/b] page on Steam and download the demo.[/p][/*][*][p]Launch the game — the main menu will display the schedule of upcoming gameplay sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]The first event begins on [b]Monday, June 9th[/b]. Check the schedule and don’t miss it — events run during set time slots![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🔍 WHAT TO EXPECT[/h2][list][*][p][b]Tight, action-packed platforming[/b] with traps, secrets, and precise movement,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Combat mechanics[/b] including bow attacks, special skills, stat upgrades, and power-ups,[/p][/*][*][p][b]An epic boss battle[/b] that sets the stage for the campaign,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Immersive atmosphere[/b] with pixel art, moody sound design, and scattered lore fragments.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🌟 THIS IS JUST THE BEGINNING[/h2][p]This demo is only the first chapter of a much larger adventure.
The [b]full version launches on June 19th, 2025[/b], featuring an expansive single-player campaign with exploration, progression, and survival in a dark, demon-infested fantasy world.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🚀 JUMP IN NOW[/h2][list][*][p]The demo has been available since [b]May 17th, 2025[/b] — you can play it today![/p][/*][*][p]The first Steam Next Fest event kicks off on [b]June 9th[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Events will take place in timed sessions, updated through the game’s main menu.[/p][/*][/list][p]Grab your bow, unlock your powers, and close the portals.
[b]The silent moon calls — and only you can save this world.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p]Let me know if you'd like this formatted for Steam, social media, or as a press release![/p]
